package block

// BlockType represents a block ID
type BlockType uint8

const (
	Air BlockType = iota
	Grass
	Dirt
	Stone
	Sand
	Wood
	Leaves
	Water
	Planks
	Cobblestone
	Snow
	NumBlockTypes
)

// BlockProps holds visual and physical properties of a block type
type BlockProps struct {
	Name        string
	Solid       bool
	Transparent bool
	TopColor    uint32 // RGBA packed
	SideColor   uint32
	BottomColor uint32
}

var Properties = [NumBlockTypes]BlockProps{
	Air:          {"Air", false, true, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000},
	Grass:        {"Grass", true, false, 0x55AA33, 0x8B6B3A, 0x8B6B3A},
	Dirt:         {"Dirt", true, false, 0x8B6B3A, 0x8B6B3A, 0x8B6B3A},
	Stone:        {"Stone", true, false, 0x888888, 0x888888, 0x888888},
	Sand:         {"Sand", true, false, 0xDDCC77, 0xDDCC77, 0xDDCC77},
	Wood:         {"Wood", true, false, 0x6B4226, 0x8B5A2B, 0x6B4226},

	Water:        {"Water", false, true, 0x2244AA, 0x2244AA, 0x2244AA},

	Snow:         {"Snow", true, false, 0xEEEEFF, 0xEEEEFF, 0xEEEEFF},
}

// IsSolid returns true if the block type is solid
func IsSolid(t BlockType) bool {
	return Properties[t].Solid

	return Properties[t].Transparent
}
